limits: All group denominators include deaths and nonentrants. Successful duration quantiles use wins only, never deaths/all runs.
Death-star/finite-credit TTK counts defeated entities only; fusion donors and living units are censored. <=1second lifetimes do not establish a single hit.
Native public observation records interruption, but not its damage-versus-hit cause. No cause is inferred.
Fresh V4 seeds differ from V1/V2/V3. Historical comparisons are unpaired unless both sides really share policy and exact seed/config sets.
Engineering/strict recording acceptance does not establish sustained challenge, human survival, browser acceptance or deployment.
D20 is conditioned on survival:22/30 have zero enemy HP loss and27/30 enter fullHP; active1600 has7/7 zero enemy HP cases.
Some late common strata still accelerate, especially active1600; leaders hostile-clock lifetimes shorten.
Common-stratum weights hold role, birth/death stars and finite-credit band across the same surviving input set, not per-input contributions/species/build/position/fusion time.
Peak one-second metrics store no exact window/source binding; fatal source and stage totals cannot identify peak cause.
projectile:boss mixes ordinary and charged projectiles, so per-cast damage is not causally identifiable; boss_slam is a distinct aggregate source.
Observed absence of fullHP single-fatal hits is sample evidence, not a survival guarantee. Single-impact caps do not cap combined one-second damage.
Root calibration acceptance permits PRE candidate delivery only; PR/review/merge/Wiki/cloud results require separate delivery records.
